name: Darius DB (Lite Version 0.1.4)
author: Darius Cumpio
announcement: Darius DB (Lite Version 0.1.4) — Local + Cloud Database Manager! Updated 'Repair All' to open the Repair dialog for review before running, plus Multi-Tab SQL Browser, DB/Table counts, resizable splitters & fast data loading!
changelog: Updated 'Repair All' button to pre-configure the Repair modal and wait for 'Run Repair Now' click before executing

Added 1-Click 'Repair All' & Full-System Diagnostics (RepairWithOptions): fixes missing folders, corrupted settings/catalog/Mailpit inbox, Cloud/Schedule configs, oversized logs, stale PIDs/temp/orphaned processes, incomplete data dirs, Windows PATH, SQL/UI caches & busy ports

Added Multi-Tab SQL Browser: click multiple tables to open each in its own tab side-by-side, click + for new SQL query tabs, close tabs with ✕/middle-click, and keep per-tab SQL, rows, filters, pagination & column widths

Added live Database & Table count badges beside Databases and Tables (<db>) headers, plus resizable/collapsible browser splitters, stretchable/auto-fit result table columns, and faster parallel/non-blocking table & MS SQL query loading

Fixed MS SQL Error 4060 ('Cannot open database ... requested by the login' / Windows Auth 'IKYOJIN\ADMIN'): resets stale Cloud database selection when switching to Local engines, validates missing Cloud profiles strictly, filters offline DBs from sys.databases, and surfaces clear actionable errors

Hardened DariusDB-Setup-0.1.4.exe & Uninstaller against antivirus/Defender false positives: replaced hidden powershell.exe shortcut scripts with native Win32 COM IShellLinkW calls and switched to clean go:embed PE packaging ready for Authenticode code signing
Show latest 10 GitHub pushes in Release Announcement & What's New with expanded scrollable view in System Version Updater

Fixed MS SQL Server Dashboard toggle turning back OFF right after starting: ignores inaccessible SYSTEM SQL Server service PIDs when locating LocalDB's sqlservr.exe, keeps LocalDB awake while switched ON (preventing idle auto-shutdown), and guards against accidental double-click stop while starting

Added Real-Time Sync Cancel & Minimize while synchronizing: Cancel Sync now aborts active MS SQL, MySQL/MariaDB & PostgreSQL exports/imports immediately on the backend, and the new ─ Minimize button beside ✕ collapses Sync into a live floating progress bar so you can keep working and restore or cancel anytime

Fixed MS SQL Server Sync & Export Msg 245 (multiline/tab text fields): escapes backslashes, CR/LF newlines, and tabs in sqlcmd queries and decodes them cleanly into single-line T-SQL CHAR(13)/CHAR(10)/CHAR(9) expressions so multi-line text never splits across rows/columns
Added Dashboard Auto-Run Toggle Bar & per-service ⚡ Auto pills: pick exactly which services auto-start on open and Start All (with 1-click presets for MySQL, MySQL + Apache, Use Running, and Clear)

Fixed slow MySQL Sync/Backup & BLOB ASCII '\0' error: added --hex-blob + hex (0x...) BLOB encoding without 64KB truncation, multi-row batched INSERTs (250 rows/256KB batches with AUTOCOMMIT=0) turning 350s imports into seconds, NUL-safe sqlEscape, --binary-mode=1 + --max-allowed-packet=256M, and live MB streaming progress

Auto-start local DB engine during Sync & 2:00 AM Auto-Sync/Backup: prevents 'connection refused on port 3306' when Dashboard services are OFF, automatically falls back between wire-compatible MySQL/MariaDB on port 3306, and fixes dark-mode input autofill background

Fixed MS SQL Server Msg 8106 on Sync: reconciles SET IDENTITY_INSERT against existing target database identity properties (prevents Msg 8106 on non-identity targets and Msg 544 on identity targets) and pauses triggers during sync

Added Daily Auto-Sync (Pull Cloud → Local) & Daily 2:00 AM Auto-Backup (.zip snapshots) with automatic 1-Week (7-Day) Snapshot Purge, Snapshot Manager, Windows Task Scheduler integration, and live per-table MS SQL export progress

Released Lite Version 0.1.4: full Cloud Database Manager, Local ↔ Cloud Sync & Full .zip Backup with real-time 0%–100% progress loading, SQL pagination (50–100 to Max/All), fixed Cloud/Sync modal widths, and fixed MS SQL Server Msg 273 timestamp/rowversion & IDENTITY sync/export

Fixed MS SQL Server Sync & Export (Msg 273 / Msg 544): excludes timestamp/rowversion and computed columns from INSERT, preserves IDENTITY(1,1) with SET IDENTITY_INSERT ON/OFF, encodes varbinary as hex (0x...), adds FK-safe refresh on Sync, suppresses '(N rows affected)' noise with SET NOCOUNT ON, and makes error logs scrollable

Added Live Percentage Progress Loading to Database Backup & Export (.zip, .sql, .csv, .bak): shows real-time 0%–100% progress bar, per-table CSV count, SQL dump size, and .zip packaging status across Cloud Cards and Database Tab
Added Live Percentage Progress Bar to Local ↔ Cloud Sync: displays real-time 0%–100% progress bar, table count, exported byte size, elapsed time, and completion/error status during push/pull sync

Fixed Cloud & Sync Modal UI Layout: set explicit modal widths so max-width wasn't capped at 410px, constrained grid inputs/selects with minmax(0, 1fr) so long Cloud Profile hostnames never clip Cloud Database inputs, and added backdrop blur

Added SQL Results Pagination: configurable page sizes (50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000, and Max/All), First/Prev/Page Numbers/Next/Last + page jump controls, automatic LIMIT/TOP expansion, and up to 250,000-row Max cap
Fixed post-update reboot crash/no-display: prevented NewManagerWithOptions(skipAdopt=true) from triggering emitStatus() before a.mgr was assigned, and added nil guard in App.emitStatus

Added 📦 Full Database Backup Archive (.zip): 1-click export containing full .sql dump, per-table UTF-8 .csv spreadsheets, and manifest.json for Local & Cloud databases (cPanel, MonsterASP.NET, etc.), plus .zip Import/Restore

Fixed PostgreSQL & StopAll Shutdown: added killProcessTree for child worker processes, pg_ctl -m immediate fallback, cancellable Prepare/Start wait, and autoStartServices=false on update reboot so Apache & Mailpit stay OFF until clicked

Added ☁️ Cloud Database System: connect cPanel (MySQL/Postgres), MonsterASP.NET / SmarterASP (MS SQL Server), Supabase, Neon, Aiven, TiDB, AWS RDS, Azure & Redis Cloud with TLS, URI/ADO.NET parser, live Test Ping, full SQL/Redis browser + CRUD, and 1-Click Local ↔ Cloud Sync

Dashboard Service Controls: Updates now stop all running engines beforehand, reboot with all Dashboard switches OFF (--all-off), clear stale 'process exited' messages, and let you cancel stuck 'starting' services with a click or Stop All
Fixed PostgreSQL custom-format dump import (auto-detects PGDMP/tar/dir dumps via pg_restore --no-owner --no-acl even when named .sql)
Fixed Auto-Updater visible reboot (--show --updated + ForceShowWindow + live main Setup binary priority) and improved Check Online build comparison

Performance Optimization: Parallel service status/adoption checks, SQL connection pooling, cached system MSSQL/PHP detection, zero-write settings checks, fast service readiness polling, debounced row filtering, and chunked Show All table rendering
Added Database Import (.sql, .csv, .bak) and Full CRUD (Create Row, Create Table, Show Details, Edit Row, Delete, Show All)
Added Single-Table, Selected-Tables, and Full-Database Export (.sql with Structure/Data toggles & .csv)
Added 1-Click GitHub System Updater with BuildID tracking, automatic update download, and automatic app restart
Added standalone DariusDB-Updater.exe and bundled Installer, Launcher, Uninstaller & Updater executables on GitHub
Fixed MySQL Error 1130 on 127.0.0.1, removed username/password from mssql.conf, and auto-provisioned sqlcmd.exe
Separated MariaDB and MySQL rows/tabs and redesigned Dashboard with Toggle-Switch rows & Full-Stack guide
Hardened PHP (Zend OPcache, PDO utf8mb4, secure sessions), Apache security headers, and MariaDB/MySQL InnoDB 256M configs
